children: Shares of European chip companies edge higher after Nvidia reported a strong set of results. Investors had been punishing stocks exposed to artificial intelligence in recent days after the departure of former Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang. Interim CEO Colette Kress reassured markets in an earnings call that Nvidia would honor its financing deals with neocloud companies. Shares of Dutch semiconductor-equipment maker ASML Holding and smaller rival ASM International are up 2.8% and 3.2%, respectively. Dutch supplier of semiconductor assembly equipment BE Semiconductor Industries is up 2.7%. German chip maker Infineon Technologies gains 2.1%. STMicroelectronics is up 1.9%. (mauro.orru@wsj.com)
